video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone selfie video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman, a young Latina woman around 26 years old with long straight glossy chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle, warm light olive skin, brown eyes, wearing an olive green fine-knit sweater, sits alone in a living room with an enclosed balcony behind her: floor-length taupe linen curtains half drawn over the glass doors, a wicker chair, a few potted plants and a warm beige wall, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. The phone rests on a tripod and the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, sincere and a little emotional, like telling a friend a personal story, with small natural head movements and expressive hand gestures in front of her chest.
